exercicios.lead: To lock in what you learned. Answers are checked right away and, if you slip, the explanation shows where and how to get it right. Your answers stay on this device only.
exercicios.avisoEmRevisao: These exercises are still under review: the team wrote them and they are waiting for a reviewer to check them. If you find a mistake, let us know; it helps everyone.
exercicios.emRevisaoDica: Not yet checked by a reviewer. If you find a mistake, let us know.
exercicios.formato: You can write it as 12, 0.75 or 3/4.
exercicios.naoEntendi: I couldn't read that number. Write just the number, like 12, 0.75 or 3/4.
exercicios.quase: Almost. Let's see where you slipped:
exercicios.semEngano: Read the question again calmly and try another option.
exercicios.voltaAmanha: This exercise comes back tomorrow for you to review, in My study. Mistakes are part of learning.
exercicios.irParaPraticar: Practice more, with exercises from other lessons

praticar.lead: Exercises that explain every mistake, one at a time. Practice freely, by track, topic and difficulty, or redo the ones you got wrong on the right day to review.
praticar.comoPraticar: How do you want to practice?
praticar.revisarLead: Exercises you got wrong come back after one day and, each time you get them right, they wait longer to return (3, 7, 14 days). That way what you learned sticks.
praticar.revisarVazio: Nothing to review today. When you get an exercise wrong, it comes back here on the right day.
praticar.respondaParaSeguir: Answer or see the solution to continue.
praticar.fimResumo: You did {n} exercises; {a} were right on the first try.
praticar.fimVoltam: {n} come back for you to review starting tomorrow.
praticar.fimAnimo: Every mistake you review is an idea that stays. Come back whenever you like.

meuEstudo.descricao: What you have studied, what is worth reviewing and how your topics are going. It stays on your device only.
meuEstudo.lead: A picture of your path so far, built from what is saved on this device. No account, no grades and no comparison with anyone.
meuEstudo.carregando: Reading what is saved on this device…
meuEstudo.vazio: Nothing is saved on this device yet. When you mark a lesson as done or take a quiz, it shows up here.
meuEstudo.soNoAparelho: None of this leaves your device. If you change phone or browser, take a copy with you (below).
meuEstudo.continuar: Pick up where you left off
meuEstudo.exerciciosHoje: {n} exercises you got wrong are due to be redone.
meuEstudo.proximaRevisao: No exercises for today; the next one comes back on {data}.
meuEstudo.semExercicioParaRevisar: No exercises to review for now.
meuEstudo.cadernoDeErros: Mistakes notebook: {n} quiz questions to redo
meuEstudo.valeReler: These lessons are worth rereading (the last quiz was below 60%):
meuEstudo.praticarLivre: Practice with the exercises with explanations
meuEstudo.semIndice: I couldn't load the track names right now (no internet?). What is saved is still here.
meuEstudo.porTemaLead: To see where it is worth reinforcing. It counts every attempt at the exercises with explanations. It is just for you: it never becomes a grade or a comparison.
meuEstudo.dadosLead: To take your progress to another device, download the copy here and open the file there. Nothing already there is lost: the two are merged.
meuEstudo.apagar: Delete my study from this device
meuEstudo.apagarDica: Deletes completed lessons, quizzes, exercises, the mistakes notebook, flashcards, the goal, the placement test and the classes. Notebook notes and sources stay. To delete everything the site saves, use My data.
meuEstudo.apagarConfirma: Delete your study from this device? This can't be undone. If you want to keep it, download the copy first.
meuEstudo.apagado: Done: {n} records deleted from this device.
meuEstudo.todosOsDados: See everything the site saves (My data)

revisao.emRevisaoDetalhe: This lesson has not been checked by a reviewer yet. You can study normally; if something looks odd, let us know.
revisao.aprovadaDetalhe: It went through the panel with the opinion of another educator in the subject; the review with role and date has not been recorded yet.

turma.descricao: Put together a sequence of lessons for your class and send the link. No sign-up and no student data collected.
turma.lead: The teacher picks the lessons and sends a link; each student follows the sequence on their own device. The sequence is written into the link and never goes through the server. Nobody needs to sign up.
turma.montarLead: Choose the lessons in the order the class should study them. You can mix tracks and subjects.
turma.adicionarTodas: Add the {n} lessons of the track
turma.passo2: 2. The sequence ({n} of at most {max} lessons)
turma.semServidor: The sequence is written into the link itself. Nothing is stored on the server.
turma.qr: QR code with the class link
turma.conferirLead: Paste here the completion codes your students sent (one or several at once). The check happens on this device.
turma.invalidos: {n} code(s) could not be read: they may have been cut or changed while copying.
turma.nenhumComprovante: No completion code found in the pasted text.
turma.avisoComprovante: The code shows what is marked on the student's device. It catches copying errors, but it is not proof against cheating: use it to start a conversation, not to give grades.
turma.tudoFeito: You completed every lesson in the sequence. Well done!
turma.aulaSumiu: This lesson was not found on the site (its address may have changed).
turma.progressoNoAparelho: Your progress stays on this device. Mark each lesson as done at the end of it.
turma.comprovanteLead: If your teacher asks, create a code with the lessons you completed and send it however you agreed. Nothing is sent automatically.
turma.seuNome: Your name (only if the teacher asks)
turma.nadaEnviado: This code was not sent to anyone. Copy it and give it to your teacher.
turma.linkQuebrado: This class link is incomplete or was changed while copying. Ask your teacher for the link again.
turma.buscarDica: Across all subjects. E.g.: fractions, photosynthesis
turma.ouEscolha: Or choose by subject and track
turma.apontar: Point your phone camera at the code
turma.mensagemWhatsapp: {titulo}: follow the lessons at this link {link}

professores.descricao: Classroom guide, lesson plans and class mode, with no sign-up and no student data collected.
professores.licenca: Lesson plan by Instituto Lúcia, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license: use, adapt and share it, crediting the source.

mapa.lead: Each mapped lesson, linked to the skills of Brazil's National Common Curriculum Base (BNCC) and the Enem Reference Matrix.
mapa.situacaoGeral: {n} links in the map; {a} still marked “to be confirmed”: the team proposed them and they are waiting for someone to check them against the official document.
mapa.aConfirmarDica: Proposed by the team; not yet checked against the official document.
mapa.avisoAula: The summary of each skill is ours; the official wording is in the documents of Brazil's Ministry of Education (MEC) and Inep. “To be confirmed” means nobody has checked it against the official document yet.
mapa.doPlano: Skills of the lessons in this plan

nivelamento.descricao: A few quick questions that only suggest which lesson to start with. You can skip it; there is no grade.
nivelamento.lead: A few questions, one per lesson, to suggest where to start. It is not a test: there is no grade, nobody sees the result and you can skip it whenever you want.
regras: There are only a few questions, one from each lesson, from the simplest to the most advanced.
Right or wrong is not shown during the test: it only suggests a starting point.
Don't know? Tap “I don't know”. That also helps the suggestion.
The result stays on this device only. You can ignore the suggestion and start wherever you like.
nivelamento.tudoFirme: From your answers, the lessons of this track covered by the test look solid. Move on to the next ones or choose any lesson.
nivelamento.fimLead: It is only a suggestion. If the lesson feels easy, move on; if it feels hard, go back one. The path is yours.
nivelamento.nenhum: There is no placement test for any track yet.
nivelamento.convite: Not sure where to start a track?

metas.lead: Optional. Choose how many lessons you want to do per week; the count starts over every Monday. No streaks and no pressure.
metas.aindaDaTempo: There is still time, and every lesson counts. If the week gets tight, that's fine: the goal is yours and can change.
metas.lembreteLead: Choose the days and time and download the reminder for your phone or computer calendar. It reminds you even with the site closed.
metas.baixado: Done. Open the file to add the reminder to your calendar.
metas.lembreteTitulo: Time to study at Instituto Lúcia
metas.lembreteDescricao: Your goal: {n} lessons per week. Pick up where you left off in My study.
metas.lembreteSemMeta: Pick up where you left off in My study.
metas.porQueNaoNotificacao: Why not a browser notification? To remind you with the site closed, the institute would have to store an address of your device on a server. The calendar file does the same without anything leaving here.

vlibras.dica: Translation of the text into Brazilian Sign Language (Libras), with an avatar. It uses VLibras, a service of the Brazilian Federal Government.
vlibras.aviso: VLibras is an external service of the Brazilian Federal Government (vlibras.gov.br). When you turn it on, this browser downloads the translator from there, and the text you choose to translate is sent to the service. Your device's network address is visible to it, as with any website. Instituto Lúcia does not control this service.
vlibras.lembrar: Remember on this device (VLibras loads by itself on the next pages)
vlibras.ligado: VLibras is on: use the blue button with a hand on the side of the screen, then tap the text you want to translate.
vlibras.erro: VLibras could not be loaded right now (no internet or the service is down). Try again later.
vlibras.esquecer: Don't load it by itself on the next pages
vlibras.desligado: VLibras is off. To use it again, just turn it on.

praticaSemPlacar.lead: Practice what you just learned: one exercise at a time, with the answer right away. No points and no day counting: the pace is yours. The voice is your device's; nothing leaves it.

guia.descricao: Five ways to help Instituto Lúcia, the path of a contribution, the lesson template and the review checklist.
guia.verGuia: Before you write, see the contribution guide: ways to help, the lesson template and the review checklist

ajudou.obrigado: Thank you. Your answer stays on this device only.
ajudou.contar: Want to tell us what was missing? Suggest an improvement.
ajudou.soma: Your answer stays on this device and adds an anonymous +1, so the team knows which lesson to redo.

enem.olho: Complete course, free, no account needed
enem.descricao: Instituto Lúcia's ENEM course: start here, diagnostic test, study plan, lessons by subject area, official exams with worked solutions, essay writing and the final stretch.
enem.lead: Everything you need to study for the whole exam using only this site: lessons, solved official exams, practice tests timed like the real exam, essay writing and a plan that fits your week. Nothing asks you to sign up; what you do stays only on this device.
enem.faltam: {n} days until day 1 of the exam ({data}).
enem.faltaUm: 1 day until day 1 of the exam ({data}).
enem.faltamDia2: {n} days until day 2 of the exam ({data}).
enem.ehHoje: Today is exam day. Good luck!
enem.jaFoi: The {ano} exam has already taken place. The answer key comes out {gabarito}.
enem.fonteDatas: Dates from the Inep official notice (the agency that runs the exam), checked on {data}.

secoes.comeceTexto: How the exam works, the score, Sisu, Prouni and Fies (university admission and funding programs), registration, quotas and what to bring on the day.
secoes.diagnosticoTexto: Sixty questions, fifteen per subject area, to see where to start. No score and no judgment.
secoes.planoTexto: Tell us how many hours you have each week and when the exam is: the plan builds your weeks with lessons, reviews, essays and practice tests.
secoes.percursoTexto: The course tracks, with what you have already studied in each one.
secoes.praticarTexto: Questions from the official exams, classified and solved by the institute, with filters for subject area, skill, content, difficulty and year.
secoes.provasTexto: The Enem exams by year and by day, timed like the real exam, with an answer sheet and worked corrections.
secoes.redacaoTexto: The structure, the five competencies, practice prompts and sourced references to use in your essay.
secoes.ferramentasTexto: Timer, essay sheet, problem solver, statistics and the labs.
secoes.retaFinalTexto: The essentials of each subject area, in order of what comes up most, formula sheets and the day before.
secoes.diaDaProvaTexto: Times, documents, what is forbidden and what to do: everything from the official notice.
secoes.simulados: Mini practice tests by subject area
secoes.simuladosTexto: A few questions from a single subject area, timed, with worked corrections.
secoes.triTexto: Why the same number of correct answers can give different scores (Item Response Theory). It does not calculate the official score.
secoes.sisuTexto: Your scores and the weights of the program you want, worked out the way Sisu does it.
secoes.oficinaTexto: Prompt, planning, a 30-line sheet with a timer and a bank of references.

enem.irParaCurso: Open the complete ENEM course: diagnostic test, plan, solved official exams, essay and final stretch

provas.lead: Each exam as it was given, by day, timed like the real thing. Mark everything on the answer sheet and check it at the end: you see your correct answers by subject area and by skill, the solution to each question and where to study what you got wrong.
provas.aviso: The questions are from Inep (public exams), taken from an open source. The worked solutions are by the institute and are under review. There is no IRT score here: only correct answers by skill and by difficulty.
provas.tempoOficial: The time for day {n} in the current edition ({t}).
provas.tempoSugerido: Suggested time ({t}), about 3 minutes per question.
provas.redacaoNoTempo: On day 1 the time includes the essay. To practice only the questions, use less time.
provas.confirmarEntrega: There are still {n} blank questions. Hand in anyway?
provas.tempoAcabou: Time is up. The exam was handed in as it was.
provas.abrirImagem: See the image at the source
provas.erroCarregar: The exam could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
provas.semResolucao: This question does not have a solution from the institute yet.
provas.erradasNoCaderno: The wrong and blank questions went to your mistakes notebook.
provas.feitas: Exams you have already taken on this device
provas.imagemNecessaria: This question depends on an image: open the image link.

praticar.lead: Questions from the official exams, classified by the institute. Choose the subject area, the skill, the content, the difficulty and the year. Feedback is instant: the explanation of the right answer and the mistake in the one you marked.
praticar.fim: You did {n} questions and got {a} right. The wrong ones went to your mistakes notebook.
praticar.nenhuma: No questions with these choices yet.
praticar.classificacao: Classification to be confirmed by the team

naAula.lead: Questions from Enem exams about what this lesson teaches, with the institute's worked solutions.

diaDaProva.lead: Everything the official notice says about the day: times, documents, what to bring and what gets you disqualified. Each item shows where it came from.
diaDaProva.checklist: Check off what you have already set aside (it stays only on this device)
diaDaProva.veja: See also the lesson on the day before and exam day

diagnostico.lead: Sixty questions from official exams, fifteen per subject area, one for each skill whenever possible. It is not a test: there is no score, nobody sees the result and you can stop whenever you want. The result stays on this device and helps build your plan.
diagnostico.area: One subject area at a time
diagnostico.areaLead: Do all four, in any order you like. Each one takes about 45 minutes.
diagnostico.fimLead: This is not a score: it is a snapshot of today, to choose where to start. The skills with the fewest correct answers come first in your plan.
diagnostico.base: Some subject areas called for a firmer foundation, and that is common: many people go back to the basics and move forward quickly. If you like, start here:
diagnostico.baseAlfabetizacao: literacy for young people and adults
diagnostico.irParaPlano: Build my plan with this result
diagnostico.feitos: Diagnostic tests taken on this device

minis.titulo: Mini practice tests by subject area
minis.lead: A few questions from official exams, from a single subject area, to practice in half an hour. Worked corrections at the end.

plano.lead: Tell us how much time you have and on which days. The plan builds the weeks until the exam with lessons and exercises, reviews, one essay a week and practice tests, starting with what comes up most. Fell behind? Redo it from today: the plan does not keep track of delays.
plano.trabalha: I work or care for someone (shorter sessions)
plano.pesos: Already chosen a program? Subject area weights (optional)
plano.pesosLead: Type the weights of the program you want, as shown on the Sisu page or the university's page. Without weights, all subject areas count the same.
plano.comDiagnostico: The plan uses your latest diagnostic test: what you got right least comes first.
plano.semDiagnostico: Without a diagnostic test, the plan follows only what comes up most.
plano.provaPassou: This year's exam has already passed: the plan applies to the next edition, for the time you chose.
plano.foraDoTempo: {n} topics did not fit in the time: they are in practice by skill, for when you have spare time.
plano.semCulpa: If the week goes off track, just redo it.

sisu.lead: Type your scores and the weights of the program you want: the calculator works out the weighted average. Nothing leaves this device.
sisu.preencha: Fill in the five scores (from 0 to 1000) and the weights.
sisu.conta: Weighted average = (score 1 × weight 1 + … + score 5 × weight 5) ÷ (weight 1 + … + weight 5)
sisu.semCorte: There is no cut-off score here: it changes every edition and is on Sisu itself, as are the weights for each program.

oficina.lead: A practice prompt, guided planning, the 30-line sheet with a timer and a review against the five competencies. Everything stays on this device; nobody grades it for you here. To get feedback, take your text to the tutoring class or to your class educator.
oficina.emRevisao: Original prompt by the institute, under review by the team.
oficina.oQueOTemaPede: What the topic asks for (read after planning)
oficina.planejarLead: Before writing, answer in a few words. What you write is saved on this device.

passos.tema: The topic, in your own words
passos.recorte: The focus: which part of the problem you will discuss
passos.argumento1: Argument 1 and the reference that supports it
passos.argumento2: Argument 2 and the reference that supports it
passos.intervencao: Intervention proposal: agent, action, means, purpose and details

oficina.tempoDica: In the exam, the essay shares day 1 with Languages and Human Sciences. Many people set aside about an hour and a half for it; practice with whatever time works for you.
oficina.repertorioLead: Laws, data, works and concepts with sources, and how to link each one to the topic. A reference only counts when it serves your argument.

progresso.lead: What you have done in the course's exams and practice tests, on this device. It is not a score: it helps you choose what to review.
progresso.porArea: Correct answers by subject area, all combined
